Job Description Summary
In simple terms, this role is about helping the region plan better and take smarter risks. You’ll bring together sales, project, supply chain and finance teams to make sure everyone is working from the same plan, while also helping tendering teams identify and manage the risks and opportunities on major grid projects before contracts are signed.

It’s a role for someone who understands how complex grid projects are delivered, can bring structure to a lot of moving parts, and is comfortable influencing people across the business without directly managing them.

Job Description
Regional S&OP & Project Risk Manager – Grid Systems Integration

Could you bring order, insight, and confidence to how one of Europe's most critical grid infrastructure businesses plans, executes, and manages risk?

GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Regional S&OP & Project Risk Manager to join our Grid Systems Integration team within North & South Europe.
------------------------------------------------------
GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. "GE" carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. "Ver" signals Earth's lush ecosystems, while "Nova" nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.
------------------------------------------------------
Electrification

Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.
------------------------------------------------------
Let's Talk about the Role

You will lead and continuously improve the Sales & Operations Planning process across our North & South Europe region, bringing together portfolio, demand, capacity, supply chain, project execution, and financial planning into one clear, connected picture.

The regional S&OP process is at an early stage of development, giving you the opportunity to help shape, establish, and embed a robust operating model across the region.

You will also bring your project risk expertise to our Tendering teams, helping identify, evaluate, and manage the risks and opportunities associated with complex grid infrastructure projects before contracts are awarded.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the heart of the business, working across functions and levels to help teams plan effectively, make informed decisions, and approach major tender opportunities with greater clarity and confidence.
------------------------------------------------------
How You Will Make a Difference

- Building and embedding a robust, sustainable S&OP operating model across North & South Europe, with clear governance, responsibilities, and operating rhythms
- Collaborating with Sales, Tendering, Project Execution, Supply Chain, Finance, Product Line, and other functional teams to align portfolio, demand, capacity, resources, and financial plans
- Facilitating cross-functional discussions that enable leadership teams to make informed decisions on capacity, resources, priorities, constraints, and business opportunities
- Identifying risks, opportunities, and potential scenarios that may impact regional business and operational plans, supporting appropriate mitigation and response actions
- Driving the identification, assessment, and mitigation of project risks and opportunities across the regional tender pipeline
- Reviewing contractual, commercial, technical, schedule, operational, and execution risks associated with tender opportunities
- Leading Risk & Opportunity reviews with stakeholders across Tendering, Project Management, Engineering, Commercial, and other relevant functions
- Supporting the development of appropriate mitigation, contingency, cost reduction, savings, and value-improvement actions
- Developing meaningful KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that turn complex project and operational data into clear, actionable insight
- Providing structured risk information and reporting to senior management to support informed decision-making and appropriate escalation
- Driving process standardisation, simplification, and continuous improvement across regional planning and governance activities
- Championing the adoption of stronger planning and governance processes through effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and change leadership

------------------------------------------------------
Skills for Success

You should be a confident communicator and natural collaborator who thrives on bringing structure to complexity, with:

- Substantive experience in the execution of complex Grid, power transmission, or Grid Systems Integration projects
- A strong understanding of the project lifecycle, from tendering through contract award and into project execution
- Experience identifying, assessing, and managing risks and opportunities within a complex project environment
- Strong understanding of how project, commercial, technical, schedule, and operational risks can impact successful tendering and execution
- The ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex business and project information and translate it into clear, practical recommendations
- Confidence engaging, facilitating, and presenting to senior leaders
- Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership capability
- The ability to operate effectively within a regional, matrix-based organisation
- The ability to lead change, establish governance, and drive adoption of new or developing processes across multiple stakeholder groups

Experience within EPC project environments, HVDC, AC substations, or other major grid infrastructure projects would be particularly valuable.

Previous exposure to Sales & Operations Planning, Integrated Business Planning, portfolio planning, operational planning, or similar cross-functional business planning processes would also be beneficial.

Experience developing or improving governance and planning processes, rather than solely operating within established frameworks, would be advantageous.

Knowledge of project risk, planning, or portfolio-management tools such as SAP, ARM, Primavera Unifier, Planisware, or equivalent systems would also be beneficial.

A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Project Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience , is preferred.
------------------------------------------------------
Where and How You'll Work

This is a permanent position with Stafford, United Kingdom as the primary UK location.

The role may also be considered from selected GE Vernova locations elsewhere within the North & South Europe region, including appropriate locations in Spain or France, subject to business requirements.

For Stafford-based employees, the role operates on a hybrid model with an expectation of approximately three days per week in the office . Hybrid arrangements for other locations will align with local business practice.

Occasional travel may be required for business meetings, tender activities, training, or other business needs. Regular travel is not expected.
------------------------------------------------------
Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That's why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world's electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!
------------------------------------------------------
We're Determined to be the Best Place to Grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We're committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.
------------------------------------------------------
Inclusion & Diversity

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to supporting disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.

Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging!

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.title: Service Sales Manager (m/w/d) - GIS & AIS
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Die Energiewende stellt die Stromnetze Deutschlands und Europas vor eine der größten technischen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Als Service Sales Manager (m/w/d) bei GE Vernova Grid Solutions — Power Transmission sind Sie mittendrin: Sie analysieren komplexe Kundenanforderungen, entwickeln technisch fundierte Lösungen und bringen Angebote erfolgreich zum Abschluss — in einem Markt, der gerade neu definiert wird.

GE Vernova's Grid Solutions — Power Transmission Business liefert hochwertige Lösungen für die Übertragungsinfrastruktur — von der Planung und Konstruktion bis zur Inbetriebnahme von Hochspannungsschaltanlagen und komplexer elektrischer Infrastruktur für Versorgungsunternehmen, Netzbetreiber und Industriekunden in Deutschland und Europa. Als Teil des Electrification-Segments von GE Vernova spielt dieses Team eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, saubere Energie zuverlässig in die Netze zu integrieren, die unsere Gesellschaft trägt.

Lust auf neue Produkte? Sie müssen nicht aus der Welt der Hochspannungsschaltanlagen kommen — wichtiger ist, dass Sie technisches Verständnis mitbringen, strukturiert denken und Freude daran haben, sich in neue, anspruchsvolle Themengebiete einzuarbeiten.

Tragen Sie aktiv zur Energiewende bei und gestalten Sie Infrastruktur mit, auf die Millionen von Menschen täglich angewiesen sind.

Job Description
Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereich
- Bearbeiten von Kundenanfragen und Ausschreibungen im Servicegeschäft — von Wartungen und Erweiterungen bis hin zu Ersatzteilen für Hochspannungsschaltanlagen (Gas-Isolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) und Freiluftschaltgeräte (AIS))
- Klären von Projektumfang und Kundenanforderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und regionalen Vertriebspartnern — von der ersten Anfrage bis zur finalen Angebotsabgabe
- Entwickeln technischer Lösungen gemeinsam mit der Service-Projektierung und Aufbereiten dieser als überzeugende Angebote und Präsentationen für den Kunden
- Abstimmen von Leistungsinhalten, Marktpreisen und Margenaufteilung mit internen Stakeholdern und Sicherstellen eines wettbewerbsfähigen Angebots im Zielmarkt
- Pflege relevanter Projekt- und Angebotsdaten in den entsprechenden Unternehmenssystemen.

- Identifizieren von Zielkunden in Abstimmung mit der Vertriebsleitung und eigenverantwortliches Durchführen von Kundenbesuchen im In- und Ausland

Ihr Profil
Voraussetzungen:
- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich — oder eine fachspezifische Berufsausbildung mit Techniker- oder Meisterabschluss und relevanter Berufserfahrung
- Technisches Verständnis im Bereich Energieversorgung, Anlagentechnik, Mittel- /-Hochspannungsschaltanlagen oder vergleichbarer Produktgruppe

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Bereitschaft zur Weiterbildung in den Spezialgebieten

- Reisebereitschaft im In- und Ausland (ca. 30%)

Von Vorteil:
- Kenntnisse im Bereich Hochspannungsschaltanlagen (GIS/AIS) oder verwandter Energietechnologien

Was bieten wir:
Bei GE Vernova glauben wir, dass eine Welt, die funktioniert, mit Menschen beginnt, die sich entfalten können. Was Sie bei uns erwartet:
- Sicherheit und Perspektive in einem zukunftsrelevanten Unternehmen

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home-Office Möglichkeiten

- Attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive leistungsorientierter Vergütungsbestandteile.

- Zugang zu GE Vernova's globalen Lern- und Weiterbildungsplattformen sowie strukturierte Einarbeitung in die Technologien und Prozesse Ihres neuen Aufgabenbereichs

- Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
- Internationale Zusammenarbeit in einem innovativen und wachsenden Markt.
- Spannende Projekte im Umfeld der Energiewende und nachhaltigen Energieversorgung
- Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit langfristigen Karriereperspektiven in einem globalen Unternehmen.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Project Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The Project Procurement Manager (PPM) is responsible for executing the sourcing deliverables for HRSG (Heat Recovery Steam Generator) MSD (Material Ship Direct) as part of the overall Project Sourcing Scope (MSD, HRSG MSD, BOP) for a project under the governance of the Project Sourcing Manager (PSM).
The PPM partners closely with the PSM to deliver best-in-class sourcing KPIs for HRSG MSD, holds full accountability for HRSG MSD equipment on-time delivery, and shares responsibility for purchase order (PO) placement timeliness. This is achieved through effective collaboration with sourcing peers (GCL, CLS, Buyer, Expeditor) and cross-functional teams.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities
ITO Handover Phase
- Lead a smooth handover of HRSG MSD sourcing scope from ITO to OTR.
- In partnership with GCL/CSL: - Verify HRSG MSD scope of delivery risks and opportunities
- Support the Project Planner in developing the HRSG MSD project schedule at the Commitment Meeting.

- Review and understand the commercial terms of the customer contract; issue project-specific purchasing conditions (PRPC) when no centralized version has been released by the PSM.

OTR Execution Phase
- Support the Project Planner in resolving disconnections within the project schedule baseline.
- Collaborate with CSL/Buyer to ensure timely PO issuance and Schedule Sign-off Completion, without impacting Vendor Document Submission Dates or Project Required Delivery Dates, by: - Ensuring Purchase Requisitions (PRs) are properly generated by conducting NACA mapping in SAP PowerMax and creating manual PRs whenever needed.
- Driving engagement from the Project team and Engineering functions whenever required.

- Lead the resolution of late POs to mitigate delivery impact, coordinating through PSM/IPM at the project level and beyond vendor-level improvements managed by CSL.
- Drive on-time Concurrent Engineering deliverables in coordination with Expeditors, Engineering, and Vendors; escalate and synergize mitigation actions through PSM, IPM, and senior leadership when project-level leakage is identified.
- Drive on-time goods delivery in collaboration with Expeditors, Engineering, Vendors, and SQE; coordinate mitigation strategies through GCL/CSL and escalate to PSM, IPM, and senior leadership as required.
- Gather inputs from Expeditors, escalate risks to PSM and the Project team within the Tier DM escalation process, develop mitigation plans, and drive issue resolution to closure.
- Participate in the Project HRSG Operating Rhythm meetings (organized by PM/IPM).
- Manage Change Orders by: - Ensuring cost impacts — negotiated by CSL — are communicated promptly within the Project Team.
- Securing Project acceptance of any associated delivery impacts.

- Support Global Daily Management activities, including weekly delivery exposure clean-up and LD (Liquidated Damages) exposure mitigation.
- Support the Vendor Documentation (VendDoc) Team as an escalation channel.
- Maintain the HRSG PPM Project Tracker.
- Manage OTR-to-ITO feedback (Lessons Learned) to ensure execution leakages related to delivery cycles, and vendor performance are fed back to ITO in a timely manner.

Strategy & Continuous Improvement
- Interface with peer GE Vernova business sourcing teams and actively participate in company-wide strategic sourcing initiatives.
- Partner with suppliers to drive improvements in on-time delivery performance for both physical products and supporting documentation.
- Establish daily management processes to support clear communication of project execution status and emerging risks.

Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university
- Minimum of 5 years of commercial experience in Sourcing, Sales, Commercial Operations, and/or Supply Chain
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
- Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Preferred
- Experience with SAP Purchasing systems
- Strong ownership mindset with a results-driven approach
- Strong quantitative and data analysis skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Proven project management and process improvement capabilities, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.title: Lead Sourcing Specialist - Buying/Procurement
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and results-focused Lead Sourcing Specialist to manage and enhance sourcing and procurement operations. This role is essential in overseeing supplier relationships, optimizing costs, facilitating contract negotiations, and ensuring timely delivery of goods and materials.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
- Place and follow-up on POs. Manage relationships with suppliers for PO execution. Manage problems and schedule changes and update ERP accordingly.

- Develop and implement sourcing strategies that balance cost-effectiveness with product quality.

- Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with new and existing suppliers.

- Build and maintain vendor relationships, ensuring performance and compliance.

- Manage CAPEX sourcing, including equipment, tooling, facilities, and infrastructure projects.

- Coordinate with internal teams to align procurement timelines and project requirements.

- Oversee bidding processes, contract negotiation, and finalization for capital projects and services.

- Work with cross-functional teams to ensure sourcing supports new product launches efficiently and cost-effectively.

- Manage RFQ processes, supplier selection, and procurement readiness for production ramp-up.

- Implement and monitor Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs to enhance supply continuity and reduce holding costs.

- Evaluate supply chain constraints and negotiate improved lead times through forecasting and capacity planning.

- Oversee procurement activities including RFQs, purchase orders, and contract execution.

- Conduct market research and assessments to inform procurement actions.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain roles.

- Ability to work in manufacturing and fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

- Industry-specific experience is advantageous.

- Proficient with Microsoft Office and ERP/procurement systems (e.g., SAP).

- Strong negotiation, evaluation, and communication skills.

- Organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Desired Characteristics
- Strong oral and written communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.

- Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

- Established project management skills.

Additional Information
GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an  Equal Opportunity Employer . Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. jobs.title: Ingénieur réglementation technique support fabrication/Manufacturing Engineering and Standards Compliance Lead H/F
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The Gas Power Technical Compliance organization (GPTC) provides technical guidance, leadership, and tactical directions to drive compliance with Technical Regulations & Standards (TRS) for products, projects & services for HD and Aero businesses. GPTC provides coverage in TRS expertise and applicability throughout the entire lifecycle of Power Generation equipment including New Product Introduction (NPI), Inquiry to Order (ITO), Order to Remittance (OTR).

GPTC is seeking a LeadEngineer (m/f/d) for driving compliance with TRS requirements for Heavy Duty & Aero Derivative Gas Power Projects execution in EMEA region, with special focus on Germany.

The Engineer will effectively collaborate internally with several functions within Gas Power & externally with customers, authorities, and authorized agencies in a multi-cultural & multi-functional environment to ensure technical compliance of products & services offered.

Descriptif/Résumé du poste
L’organisation Gas Power Technical Compliance (GPTC) fournit des conseils techniques, un leadership et des orientations tactiques pour favoriser la conformité des produits, projets et services aux réglementations et normes techniques (TRS) pour les branches HD et Aero. L’organisation met au service de l’entreprise son expertise TRS ainsi que ses directives en matière d’applicabilité des réglementations et normes techniques tout au long du cycle de vie des équipements de production d’énergie, notamment pendant les phases NPI (Introduction de nouveaux produits), ITO (Demande d’informations - Commande) et OTR (Commande-Livraison).

L’organisation GPTC recherche un/une ingénieur(e) chargé(e) d’assurer la conformité avec les exigences TRS dans le cadre de l'exécution des projets Gas Power Heavy Duty et Aero Derivative dans la région EMEA, avec une attention particulière sur l'Allemagne.

Il/Elle collaborera efficacement en interne avec plusieurs services au sein de Gas Power et en externe avec les clients, les autorités et les agences autorisées, dans un environnement multiculturel et multifonctionnel, pour assurer la conformité technique des produits et services offerts.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities

- Drive project regulatory compliance for all technologies part of Power Plants (GT, GEN, ST, BOP, HRSG, Controls) and for all TRS categories (Environmental compliance, Pressure equipment compliance, Explosive atmospheres compliance, machinery safety compliance, etc.) for Gas Power Heavy-Duty and  Aero-Derivative Units.
- Flow down regulatory requirements to engineering, sourcing and other functions as required.
- Collect contractual Codes & Standards requirements and build a compliance strategy plan.
- Conduct regulatory compliance assessments and manages project technical compliance plans to meet the requirements by reviewing and understanding the applicable Regulations and referenced Standards
- Partner with Manufacturing, Design & field teams to successfully resolve regulatory compliance issues
- Assist equipment inspections & audits in manufacturing as well as customer sites as needed for codes & standards compliance requirements
- Interact with outside engineering firms, certification and inspection agencies, governmental agencies, authorities to provide product compliance with applicable regional or national Technical Regulations to gain the needed product certification or registration.
- Maintain awareness of the latest technical regulations developments.
- Coordinate a team of compliance project engineers
- Serve as an approver for TRS information packages or technical files for its eventual submission to authorities
- Manage project schedule and cost of TRS compliance for the scope of work
- Lead the solution of technical problems related to compliance of equipment to technical regulations
- Monitor and effectively communicate project status, business issues and potential non-compliance risks for the project
- Participate as a presenter in technical and project reviews
- Communicate results/actions to the relevant engineering and project teams
- Act independently in achieving project TRS compliance
- Has in-depth knowledge of best practices and interfaces with others; has working knowledge of competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market
- Be proactive towards business initiatives such as Quality, PLM multi-generation roll out, Productivity (Lean), Product Cost Out (PCO) and continuous improvement
- Work within the guidelines of applicable internal Policies and Procedures, Engineering Standards
- Promote & Prioritize “Safety” culture as per GE Vernova Spirit & Letter Policies

- Piloter la conformité réglementaire des projets pour toutes les technologies utilisées dans les centrales électriques (turbines à gaz, alternateurs, turbines à vapeur, systèmes auxiliaires, chaudières de récupération de chaleur, contrôles) et pour toutes les catégories de TRS (conformité environnementale, conformité des équipements sous pression, conformité des atmosphères explosives, conformité de la sécurité des machines, etc.) pour les unités industrielles et aérodérivées
- Transférer les exigences réglementaires aux équipes Ingénierie, Achats et aux autres services, selon les besoins
- Recueillir les exigences contractuelles en matière de codes et de normes et élaborer un plan de stratégie de conformité
- Effectuer des évaluations de la conformité réglementaire et gérer les plans de conformité technique du projet pour répondre aux exigences en examinant et en analysant les réglementations applicables et les normes référencées
- Collaborer avec les équipes Fabrication et Conception et les équipes de terrain pour résoudre les problèmes de conformité réglementaire
- Apporter son soutien lors des audits et des inspections des équipements sur les sites de fabrication et sur les sites client, selon les besoins, en ce qui concerne les exigences de conformité aux codes et aux normes
- Interagir avec les sociétés d'ingénierie externes, les agences de certification et d'inspection, les agences gouvernementales et les autorités pour assurer la conformité des produits avec les réglementations techniques régionales ou nationales applicables, afin d'obtenir les certifications ou les enregistrements nécessaires pour les produits
- Se tenir au courant des derniers développements en matière de réglementations techniques
- Coordonner une équipe d'ingénieurs projet Conformité
- Approuver les dossiers d'information ou les dossiers techniques TRS en vue de leur soumission aux autorités
- Gérer le calendrier du projet et le coût de la conformité TRS pour l'étendue des travaux
- Diriger la résolution des problèmes techniques liés à la conformité des équipements avec les réglementations techniques
- Surveiller et communiquer efficacement l'état du projet, les problèmes commerciaux et les risques potentiels de non-conformité pour le projet
- Participer en qualité de présentateur/trice à des revues techniques ou de programmes
- Communiquer les résultats/actions aux équipes Ingénierie et Projet concernées
- Agir de manière indépendante pour assurer la conformité TRS du projet
- Connaître les bonnes pratiques et savoir dans quelle mesure son propre domaine d’activité s’intègre à celui des autres ; connaître les concurrents et les facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché
- Faire preuve de proactivité en ce qui concerne les initiatives de la branche, telles que la qualité, le déploiement du PLM multigénérationnel, la productivité (Lean), la réduction des coûts des produits (PCO) et l'amélioration continue
- Travailler dans le respect des politiques et procédures internes applicables, et des normes d'ingénierie
- Promouvoir et favoriser la culture de la « sécurité » conformément aux politiques de GE Vernova

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering or science from an accredited college or university (this is a Must for Hungary) or equivalent experience (Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical or Computer Science & Electrical Engineer preferred)
- Demonstrated expertise in the technical regulatory space (e.g. ISO12100, IEC61508/11, EU PED, ATEX, , Electrical Safety, EMC, Machinery directive, Building Code etc.) either certified by an external entity or by experience in a technology or set of industrial products
- Demonstrated expertise in German local regulations, including interaction with professional Engineers
- Demonstrated experience of executing turnkey projects located in Germany from the TRS, Engineering or Project Management perspective
- Demonstrated ability in managing high impact or complex regulatory compliance projects across functions
- Demonstrated experience in successfully interacting with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs)
- Prior experience in working with regulatory compliance agencies like TUV, UL, Intertek or similar
- Knowledge in Energy Industry
- Effective written and oral communication skills in English and German
- Fluent English and German language
- Demonstrated interpersonal and leadership experience
- High level of Integrity

- Diplômé en ingénierie ou en sciences, en électricité et électronique, en mécanique ou en informatique
- Expertise avérée dans le domaine de la réglementation technique (par exemple, ISO12100, CEI61508/11, règlement EU PED, ATEX, sécurité électrique, CEM, directives relatives aux machines, code du bâtiment, etc.) certifiée par une entité externe ou validée par une expérience dans une technologie précise ou un ensemble de produits industriels
- Expertise avérée en matière de réglementations locales allemandes, impliquant des interactions avec des ingénieurs

Nous recherchons un Responsable Achats Stratégiques : Installation, Mise en service et Génie Civil (H/F) qui sera le garant de notre stratégie d'achat globale et régionale sur les activités d’installation, mise en service et génie civil.

Votre mission sera de sécuriser la compétitivité, la capacité de production et la conformité technique de notre base fournisseurs, bien avant le lancement opérationnel des projets.

jobs.title: Project Supply Chain Manager/ Responsable de la chaine d’approvisionnement
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Nous recherchons un pour Responsable de la chaine d’approvisionnement l’entité Hydroélectrique Amérique du Nord de GE Vernova.

La lutte contre le changement climatique est une priorité mondiale. En tant qu’entreprise dont la technologie est utilisée pour alimenter environ 25 % de l’électricité dans le monde, nous prenons notre responsabilité au sérieux. GE Vernova est une entreprise qui prend part à une nouvelle ère énergétique – électrifiant le monde tout en travaillant à le décarboniser. Nous accélérons la transition vers une énergie plus fiable, abordable et durable, tout en aidant nos clients à alimenter des économies et à fournir l'électricité essentielle à la santé, à la sûreté, à la sécurité et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie.
L'activité Hydroélectrique de GE Vernova conçoit, développe, fabrique et entretient des technologies avancées qui exploitent la puissance de l'eau pour fournir une énergie fiable et durable. Depuis plus d’un siècle, l’hydroélectricité joue un rôle essentiel dans les systèmes électriques nord-américains et mondiaux. Aujourd’hui, il s’agit de la plus grande source d’énergie renouvelable au monde, et la technologie pompage-turbinage représenta la plus grande source de stockage d’énergie. Mais pour atteindre zéro émission nette à l’échelle mondiale d’ici 2050, nous devons doubler la quantité d’hydroélectricité existante. Que ce soit par pompage-turbinage, au fil de l’eau ou en mettant à niveau la base installée existante, l’hydroélectricité continuera d’être la pierre angulaire de l’avenir énergétique de l’Amérique du Nord.
Avez-vous l'énergie pour changer le monde ? Si vous êtes prêt à faire la différence et à entrer dans la nouvelle ère énergétique, rejoignez-nous. Vous aurez l'opportunité d'évoluer et de grandir parmi les esprits les plus brillants du secteur, de travailler sur des technologies de pointe et de faire partie d'une équipe mondiale d'environ 75 000 personnes réparties dans plus de 100 pays.

Le gestionnaire de commodité est responsable de la stratégie d’approvisionnement de biens et services dans le cadre de projets de réalisation de groupes turbine-alternateurs de projets hydroélectriques. Il peut s’agir principalement d’auxiliaires mécaniques ou électriques, de structures mécano-soudées, de pièces forgées et coulées et de composantes d’alternateur.

We are looking for a Project Supply Chain Manager for our Hydro Power North America division within GE Vernova.

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority. As a company whose technology is used to power ~25% of the world’s electricity, we take our responsibility seriously. GE Vernova is a purpose-built company leading a new era of energy – electrifying the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it. We are accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life.
GE Vernova’s Hydro Power business designs, develops, manufactures, and services advanced technologies that harness the power of water to deliver reliable and sustainable power. For more than a century, hydropower has played an essential role in the North American and global electricity systems. Today, hydropower is the world’s largest source of renewable energy, and its pumped storage technology is the world’s largest source of energy storage. But to reach net-zero globally by 2050, we need to double the amount of hydro currently installed. Whether it’s through pumped storage, run-of-river, or by upgrading the existing installed base, hydropower will continue to be a cornerstone of North America’s energy future.
Do you have the energy to change the world? If you are ready to make a difference and usher in the new era of energy, come join us. You will get the opportunity to evolve and grow, surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the industry, work on cutting-edge technologies, and be part of a global team of ~75,000 people across more than 100 countries.

jobs.title: Senior Governance Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
What if you could spend your days not just maintaining security programs — but reimagining how they work? As a Staff Risk Analyst within GE Vernova's Power segment Digital Technology (DT) Governance & Compliance organization, you will take direct ownership of two enterprise-level security programs and have the mandate to make them smarter, leaner, and more impactful.

This is a role for someone who gets energized by both the rigor of operational excellence and the freedom to challenge how things are done — someone who sees automation not as a future ambition, but as something they are already building today.

Job Description
About the Role
You will own end-to-end execution of the Enterprise Vulnerability Management (EVM)  and Disaster Recovery (DR)  programs for the entire Power segment — while simultaneously driving process simplification, optimization, and automation, including the use of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workflows.
Reporting directly to the Power DT Governance & Compliance Leader, you will coordinate across application teams and senior Technology and Cyber leaders, translating operational data into clear, actionable insights for leadership. Beyond EVM and DR, you will play a key role in Power DT's Governance Optimization program — a strategic initiative focused on reducing governance burden across the organization so the team can concentrate on what truly moves the needle.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead cyber vulnerability management  — Own identification, tracking, and resolution of vulnerabilities across all Power DT applications in line with EVM and NIS2 (Network and Information Security Directive) requirements; maintain the risk register, manage escalations, drive root cause analysis, and report regularly to leadership on status and trends.
- Drive governance and process improvement  — Contribute to the Governance Optimization program by identifying inefficiencies, redesigning processes from first principles, and deploying AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual effort and increase program maturity.
- Support risk management and policy  — Assist in risk assessments, document findings, and help maintain IT policies and procedures covering security, data management, and access control — keeping compliance repositories current and audit-ready.
- Build reporting and visibility  — Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that give senior leadership a clear view of IT risk posture, compliance status, and control effectiveness; validate data integrity and support Key Performance Indicator (KPI) / Key Risk Indicator (KRI) reporting.
- Enable a culture of awareness  — Help develop training materials and coordinate sessions that build understanding of compliance obligations and best practices across the organization; track participation and capture feedback.
- Support audit readiness  — Organize documentation, respond to evidence requests, and support audit coordination activities to ensure the team is consistently prepared.

Who We're Looking For
You are an analytical, intellectually curious problem-solver who brings both operational discipline and a genuine passion for innovation — especially at the intersection of AI, automation, and cybersecurity governance.
Required
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field — or 1–3 years of equivalent practical experience in Cyber, IT Audit, or a related field
- 1–3 years of experience with foundational knowledge of security and application controls
- Hands-on curiosity with AI tools and workflow automation — you build, test, and iterate, and treat automation as core to how you work
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to support control gap identification and basic root cause analysis
- Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills — equally effective with technical teams and senior leadership
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
- Proficiency in data analysis, including Microsoft Excel; willingness to develop skills in reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Preferred
- Interest in or progress toward relevant certifications such as CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
- Familiarity with COBIT (Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies) frameworks or SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance requirements
- Experience with dashboard development and KPI/KRI reporting in a governance or risk context

Education
A formal education and subsequent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline is nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.

Why GE Vernova
GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. We offer a robust benefits package depending on your employment status and national requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Risk & Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The Staff Risk Analyst will oversee the Cybersecurity and Risk function across different GE business sites, presence and interests.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Support governance framework : Assist in maintaining the IT governance structure using established frameworks; help update documentation, track process adherence, and support standardization efforts under senior guidance.

- SOX Compliance Management: Support the Power DT Sarbanes-Oxley compliance program by coordinating testing activities, managing documentation requirements, and ensuring timely completion of control assessments. Collaborate with process owners to maintain accurate control narratives, risk-control matrices, and test evidence in accordance with SOX requirements. Track testing cycles, identify control gaps or weaknesses, and facilitate management's remediation efforts. Prepare SOX status reports for leadership and external auditors, maintain the SOX controls repository, and stay current on regulatory changes and industry best practices to ensure continuous compliance with financial reporting requirements.
- End-to-End Deficiency Management : Lead comprehensive deficiency identification, tracking, and resolution processes across all GRC domains. Collaborate with control owners and business stakeholders to document findings, assign remediation actions with clear deadlines, and monitor progress through to closure. Maintain deficiency registers, provide regular status reporting to leadership, perform root cause analysis, and ensure timely escalation of overdue or high-risk items. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing deficiency trends and recommending preventive measures to strengthen the organization's control environment.
- Support key control domains : Assist in ERP control areas (Identity and Access Management/Privileged Access, SDLC/DevOps change, and IT operations) by performing routine control testing, maintaining evidence files, and supporting standardization initiatives.
- Support policy development : Assist in drafting and updating IT policies and procedures for security, data management, and access control; help coordinate review processes, track acknowledgments, and maintain policy repositories to support continuous compliance.
- Support risk management : Assist in risk assessment activities by gathering data, documenting findings, and maintaining risk registers; help identify and document risks associated with IT systems, including cybersecurity threats and data breaches, under senior supervision.
- Support compliance audits : Serve as a key support resource for internal and external audits; assist in managing request lists, gathering evidence, organizing documentation, responding to routine inquiries, and tracking remediation progress for identified control deficiencies.
- Monitor regulatory adherence : Help monitor changes in regulations and laws, such as SOX, NIS2, and GDPR; assist in maintaining control and policy mappings and support updates to ensure ongoing compliance.
- Support training and awareness : Assist in developing training materials and coordinating training sessions for employees and stakeholders; help track participation and gather feedback to support understanding of compliance obligations and best practices.
- Support reporting : Assist in building and maintaining reports and dashboards for senior management on IT risk posture, compliance status, and control effectiveness; help gather data, validate information, and prepare routine status updates.

What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)
- Experience : Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 1-3 years in IT GRC, IT Audit, or related fields with foundational knowledge of SOX ITGCs and application controls; any ERP exposure is beneficial.
- ERP awareness : Basic understanding of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and interest in learning Segregation of Duties (SoD) concepts, access controls, and configuration standards.
- Learning mindset : Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced environment; eagerness to understand business objectives and how control activities support organizational goals.
- Continuous improvement : Strong curiosity, first-principles problem solving, and interest in process improvement and metrics-driven approaches.
- Analytical skills : Good problem-solving and analytical skills to support control gap identification, risk assessment activities, and basic root-cause analysis under guidance.
- Communication : Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to document findings clearly and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Collaboration : Demonstrated ability to work effectively in team environments, support cross-functional initiatives across IT, Finance, and business partners, and learn from senior team members.
- Technology aptitude : Basic familiarity with GRC concepts and willingness to learn GRC/security tooling and dashboards; interest in contributing to process improvements and automation initiatives.
- Professional development : Interest in pursuing relevant certifications such as CISA, CISM, or CRISC; openness to learning about COBIT frameworks and SOX requirements.
- Audit support : Willingness to learn audit processes and evidence management; ability to organize documentation, respond to routine requests, and support audit coordination activities.
- Data and reporting : Basic proficiency with data analysis tools and interest in learning dashboard development; familiarity with Excel and willingness to learn tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

What will make you stand out
- Certifications : Interest in pursuing CISA certification within 1-2 years; basic understanding of SOX requirements; foundational knowledge of CISM, CRISC, or COBIT frameworks beneficial; willingness to learn about ISO 27001 standards.
- ERP risk foundation : Basic understanding of ERP systems (Oracle EBS, preferred); willingness to develop knowledge of critical access controls, configuration standards, and automated control testing; exposure to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Saviynt) a plus.
- Audit/exam support : Demonstrated organizational skills and attention to detail for supporting audit processes; ability to assist with evidence gathering, maintain PBC (Provided by Client) lists, and support routine audit inquiries; eagerness to learn internal and external audit processes (SOX) and contribute to smooth audit execution.
- Data analysis and reporting : Basic proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools; familiarity with Excel and willingness to learn advanced reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau; ability to support control analytics and assist in developing KPI/KRI reports under guidance; strong attention to detail in data validation and documentation.

This Job Description is intended to provide a high-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required from each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager.

A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements, competitive benefits, and great development opportunities.

---

Intégrez une équipe gagnante et participez à la mise en œuvre de la transition énergétique au sein de GE Vernova Hydro Power.

Basé(e) dans notre bureau de Grenoble (France), le/la Chargé de projets achats pour la région EMEA pilotera l'exécution des bons de commande de produits électriques auprès de fournisseurs européens. Ce poste implique une étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénierie, Qualité, Planification et Achats, ainsi qu’avec d'autres parties prenantes clés, et son champ d’application concerne les équipements électriques associés à de longs délais de livraison.

Le/La titulaire du poste devra gérer des priorités en constante évolution, avec peu de supervision, et maintenir une communication efficace avec les parties prenantes internes, la haute direction et les fournisseurs.

Job Description
GE Vernova:  Leading a New Era of Energy

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority. If we want our energy future to be different … we must be different. That is our singular mission.​

GE, the 130-year-old energy pioneer. Our unwavering commitment to powering the planet, now fully focused on the energy transition. No company has the unique combination to pioneer what’s next – just as we have before. As we answer the call with renewed purpose and vigor, we are moving our GE energy businesses—including Renewables, Power, Digital and Energy Financial Services — under one banner to deliver a united, focused, one-of-a-kind force: GE Vernova. Together, with our customers and partners, we will chart the course to a better future.

Our mission is embedded in our new name. We retain our treasured birthright, “GE,” in our name as an enduring and hard-earned badge of quality and ingenuity. “Ver,” “verde,” “verdant,” all signal Earth’s verdant and lush ecosystems. “Nova,” from the Latin “novus,” nods to a new, innovative era of lower carbon energy that GE Vernova will help deliver.

Our new name sounds different, because it is. GE Vernova will act swiftly and surely to help build a cleaner, better future. This is not business as usual: this is business purpose-built to lead the new era of energy.

Roles and Responsibilities:
- Leads follow-up activities for long-lead critical purchase orders (POs) in EPC hydroelectric power plant projects.

- Manages supplier relationships throughout PO execution.

- Addresses progress issues and schedule changes to ensure on-time delivery.

- Maintains the ERP system with accurate and up-to-date forecasts.

- Resolves issues using established procedures and technical expertise.

- Collaborates with Engineering, Quality, Planning, and other stakeholders to ensure quality and on-time delivery.

- Leads discussions with suppliers during execution regarding claims, scope changes, and related matters, in coordination with Project Teams.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline from a reputable university.

- 6–12 years of experience in engineering, sourcing, and/or manufacturing of electrical and/or mechanical systems in Project based business environments.

- Self-directed, detail-oriented, well-organized, and adaptable.

- Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, Smartsheet, and other office productivity software.

- Experience with contract execution in Procure-to-Pay processes using SAP-based ERP systems.

- Fluent in English (spoken and written).

Desired Characteristics

- Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management or a related discipline from a reputable university.

- Knowledge of French or German is an asset.

- Experience in the energy industry, particularly hydropower projects, is a strong plus.

- Demonstrated ability and ownership to drive improvements and change with tangible results.

- Strong aptitude for working in a global environment and matrix organization.

Please send your CV written in English.

---
FR Version

GE Vernova ouvre la voie vers une nouvelle ère énergétique

La crise climatique est une urgence mondiale qui doit être prise au sérieux. Si nous voulons que notre avenir énergétique change … nous devons changer. C'est là toute notre mission.

GE est un pionnier de l'énergie depuis 130 ans. Notre engagement indéfectible à alimenter la planète en énergie est désormais entièrement axé sur la transition énergétique. Aucune entreprise ne possède les compétences spécifiques que nous avons mises en œuvre pour ouvrir la voie vers l'avenir. jobs.title: Global Lean Leader – Sales & Commercial / Responsable Lean Monde (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Do you want to drive the future of operational excellence for our global Electrification business?

GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Global Lean Leader – Sales & Commercial to join our Electrification team based in Rugby, UK, Paris, France, or Pennsylvania, US.

GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Electrification

Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.

Job Description
Let’s Talk about the Role

The Global Lean Leader – Sales & Commercial will drive and oversee the implementation of Lean methodologies, within the Sales & Commercial functions, across the Power Conversion & Storage (PCS) organization. This role will ensure that business processes are continuously improved to maximize efficiency, facilitate cross-site & cross-functional collaboration, coach local teams on Lean practices, serve as a central resource for knowledge and best practice sharing, and drive a culture of operational excellence on a global scale. Keeping productivity at the core of continuous process improvement, you will employ various productivity tools/drivers (i.e. AI, Automation) to deliver significant efficiency gains, at scale, within the Sales & Commercial functions.

How You Will Make a Difference

• Leading the global strategy for Sales and Commercial Lean implementation to ensure full alignment with our organizational business objectives.
• Driving significant productivity gains by integrating advanced efficiency tools and automation into existing commercial workflows.
• Building a culture of continuous improvement through high-impact Lean training and mentorship programs for employees at all levels.
• Collaborating with regional and functional leaders to solve complex operational challenges and standardize global processes.
• Improving visibility and accountability by defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and utilizing data-driven insights to track progress.
• Developing and championing change management initiatives that secure stakeholder buy-in and ensure the long-term adoption of Lean practices.

Skills for Success

You should be a collaborative change agent with a proven track record of leading global transformation efforts, featuring:

• The expertise to apply Lean methodologies—such as Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, and A3 Problem Solving—to drive measurable commercial results.
• The capability to influence and lead cross-functional, diverse teams across different geographic regions.
• An understanding of how to bridge the gap between complex technical operations and high-level commercial sales strategies.
• The ability to utilize data-driven decision-making to identify bottlenecks and report on the impact of Lean initiatives.
• A keen interest in leveraging emerging technologies like AI and automation to scale efficiency gains.

A formal education and subsequent University Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Sales/Commercial Management, or a related field are nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.

Where and how you'll work
• This is a permanent position based in our UK, France, or US office.
• We have a remote and hybrid working model which gives you flexibility to work from our offices and from home.

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between  $128,400.00 and $213,900.00 USD.  The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus.

This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on October 16th, 2026.

Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to Health Coach from GE Vernova, a 24/7 nurse-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Vernova Retirement Savings Plan, a tax-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and financial planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, 12 paid holidays, and permissive time off.

Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

We're determined to be the best place to grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.

Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Souhaitez-vous piloter l'avenir de l'excellence opérationnelle pour notre activité mondiale d'électrification ?

GE Vernova recherche un(e) Global Lean Leader – Sales & Commercial exceptionnel(le) pour rejoindre notre équipe Electrification basée à Rugby (Royaume-Uni), Paris (France) ou en Pennsylvanie (États-Unis).

GE Vernova - L'énergie de changer le monde

Avec plus de 130 ans d'expérience et d'innovations éprouvées, GE Vernova mène une nouvelle ère de l'énergie. Nous électrifions le monde tout en œuvrant à sa décarbonation. Notre nom reflète notre mission : « GE » porte un héritage de qualité et d'ingéniosité, « Ver » évoque les écosystèmes luxuriants de la Terre, et « Nova » fait écho à une nouvelle ère d'énergie à faible teneur en carbone que nous aidons à fournir.

Tourné vers l'avenir, GE Vernova accélère la transition vers une énergie fiable, abordable et durable. Nous aidons nos clients à alimenter les économies et à fournir l'électricité essentielle à la santé, à la sécurité et à la qualité de vie.

Electrification

Nos solutions d'électrification modernisent les réseaux, favorisent l'intégration des énergies renouvelables et renforcent les systèmes énergétiques. Des logiciels à la conversion et au stockage de l'énergie, nous aidons à créer des réseaux énergétiques plus intelligents et plus résilients.

Parlons du poste

Le/La Global Lean Leader – Sales & Commercial pilotera la mise en œuvre des méthodologies Lean au sein de nos fonctions Ventes et Commerciales mondiales afin de maximiser l'efficacité et l'impact opérationnel.

Vous agirez en tant qu'autorité centrale pour l'amélioration des processus et la transformation culturelle au sein de notre organisation Power Conversion & Storage. En tirant parti de votre expertise des pratiques Lean et d'outils de productivité modernes — tels que l'IA et l'automatisation — vous identifierez les goulots d'étranglement, coacherez des équipes interfonctionnelles et établirez une norme mondiale en matière d'excellence opérationnelle. Vous jouerez à la fois un rôle de stratège et de mentor de terrain, garantissant que nos processus commerciaux soient non seulement efficaces, mais aussi évolutifs et durables.

Comment vous ferez la différence

• Diriger la stratégie mondiale de mise en œuvre du Lean dans les ventes et le commerce afin d'assurer un alignement total avec nos objectifs commerciaux.
• Générer des gains de productivité significatifs en intégrant des outils d'efficacité avancés et l'automatisation dans les flux de travail commerciaux existants.
• Bâtir une culture d'amélioration continue grâce à des programmes de formation et de mentorat Lean à fort impact pour les employés à tous les niveaux.
• Collaborer avec les responsables régionaux et fonctionnels pour résoudre des défis opérationnels complexes et standardiser les processus mondiaux.
• Améliorer la visibilité et la responsabilité en définissant des indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) et en utilisant des données pour suivre les progrès.
• Développer et promouvoir des initiatives de gestion du changement qui garantissent l'adhésion des parties prenantes et l'adoption à long terme des pratiques Lean.

Compétences pour réussir

Vous êtes un(e) agent(e) du changement collaboratif(ve) avec une expérience avérée dans la conduite d'efforts de transformation mondiaux, doté(e) de :

• L'expertise nécessaire pour appliquer les méthodologies Lean — telles que la cartographie de la chaîne de valeur (VSM), Kaizen et la résolution de problèmes A3 — pour obtenir des résultats commerciaux mesurables.
• La capacité d'influencer et de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et diversifiées à travers différentes régions géographiques.
• La compréhension de la manière de combler le fossé entre les opérations techniques complexes et les stratégies de ventes commerciales de haut niveau.
• La capacité à utiliser la prise de décision basée sur les données pour identifier les inefficacités et rapporter l'impact des initiatives Lean.
• Un vif intérêt pour l'exploitation des technologies émergentes comme l'IA et l'automatisation afin d'accroître les gains d'efficacité.

Une formation universitaire formelle (Bachelor ou Master) en commerce, ingénierie, gestion commerciale ou dans un domaine connexe est appréciée, mais nous nous intéressons avant tout à votre expérience globale et à vos réalisations professionnelles.

Où et comment vous travaillerez
• Il s'agit d'un poste permanent basé dans nos bureaux de Rugby (Royaume-Uni), Paris (France) ou en Pennsylvanie (États-Unis).
• Nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui vous offre la flexibilité de travailler depuis nos bureaux et depuis votre domicile.

Notre culture

Chaque action façonne notre avenir. C'est pourquoi notre étoile polaire est une culture d'impact, où chacun est habilité à s'épanouir et à réussir.

Répondre au besoin urgent de construire un système d'énergie électrique plus durable tout en améliorant la trajectoire des émissions liées au changement climatique sont des priorités mondiales, et nous prenons notre responsabilité au sérieux. Telle est notre mission chez GE Vernova : continuer à électrifier pour permettre au monde de prospérer et de se décarboner. Nous jouons un rôle significatif dans la conduite d'une nouvelle ère de l'énergie.

Notre technologie aide à générer environ 25 \% de l'électricité mondiale aujourd'hui, et nous travaillons pour alimenter le reste. Si vous souhaitez que l'avenir de l'énergie soit différent, rejoignez-nous pour faire la différence. Ensemble, nous sommes l'énergie du changement !

Nous sommes déterminés à être le meilleur endroit pour évoluer

Nous pensons que les carrières solides se construisent sur une variété d'expériences, des liens forts et un développement continu. Nous nous engageons à vous fournir les outils pour naviguer et façonner un parcours professionnel solide, en accord avec un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Chaque carrière est unique, et la vôtre doit refléter vos objectifs personnels et professionnels. Votre responsable d'équipe et vos mentors vous soutiendront tout au long de votre parcours.

Nous privilégions également une rémunération équitable, des récompenses basées sur la performance et des programmes de bien-être pour vous et votre famille. Avec des opportunités de mobilité entre les équipes et les fonctions, votre carrière peut continuer à évoluer tandis que la durabilité reste au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Inclusion et diversité

Nous sommes passionnés par la création d'un environnement de travail inclusif. En valorisant les idées et les contributions d'une main-d'œuvre diversifiée, nous aidons à inspirer les autres à grandir, à réussir et à placer la barre plus haut pour tout le monde.

En tant qu'employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et pratiquant l'action positive, GE Vernova s'engage à soutenir les groupes défavorisés tout en offrant des opportunités égales aux collaborateurs de GE Vernova comme aux candidats.

Rejoignez-nous chez GE Vernova, où les résultats sont obtenus en embrassant une communauté d'appartenance.

As the Advanced Programs Manager, you will play a pivotal leadership role in orchestrating, executing, and expanding our DOD and federal energy and power systems technology portfolio. You will be responsible for the strategic oversight of facilities and the lifecycle management of new, high-stakes programs. This role requires a unique blend of technical program management and business development acumen to identify and capture new opportunities that push the boundaries of current power generation, distribution, and storage applications. You will serve as a key point of contact for government agencies while maintaining and leveraging existing security clearances to drive growth in the classified and advanced technology space. You will shape and foster strategic collaborations with Universities and strategic technology / business/ external partners to drive innovative power systems and novel integrated system solutions for GE Vernova.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities:
As part of a multi-disciplinary team, you will lead and contribute to the planning, development, and transition of technologies from concept to products and/or services for GE internal and external clients.

You will:

- Develop and lead the strategy for expanding our DOD portfolio, identifying new market opportunities in advanced power systems.
- Oversee the lifecycle of advanced energy programs, including the management of specialized research facilities and the technical execution of multidisciplinary projects.
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of government and defense-related opportunities, ensuring a continuous flow of high-impact power and energy work.
- Act as the primary interface for classified and high-security government collaborations (e.g., Rome Labs), maintaining strong relationships and ensuring compliance with all security protocols.
- Coordinate across GE Vernova’s business units to integrate advanced power technologies into long-term strategic plans and multi generational technology roadmaps.
- Oversee facilities and resources, ensuring that programs are delivered on time, within scope, and in full alignment with security requirements.
- Provide technical leadership and expertise in Power Systems and Integrated Systems to develop and implement innovative solutions that enhance system performance, efficiency, security and reliability.
- Drive technical strategy for data center integrated power systems as well as develop the technology and product roadmaps and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
- Lead early stage technology development with high disruption potential and mature these technologies from initial concept to successful product introduction.

- Demonstrated capability to thrive in a matrixed team environment.

Job Description Summary
The Project Procurement Team Leader (PPTL) supports the Procurement Manager in leading procurement execution across Grid Solutions projects in the North America region.
The PPTL is responsible for overseeing a team of project buyers and PPLMs (Project Procurement Logistics Manager) to ensure that all procurement activities are executed on time, within budget, and in full compliance with GE Vernova sourcing policies. Acting as the first line of leadership and escalation, the PPTL drives operational performance, KPI achievement, and continuous improvement to support successful project delivery.

Job Description

The Role
The Project Procurement Team Leader (PPTL) partners with the Procurement Manager to drive procurement execution across Grid Solutions projects in the North America region for the specific product line.
The PPTL leads a team of Project Buyers and Project Procurement & Logistics Managers (PPLMs), ensuring that all procurement activities are executed efficiently, on schedule, and within budget, while fully adhering to GE Vernova’s sourcing policies.
As the first line of leadership and escalation, the PPTL takes charge of operational performance, actively driving KPI achievement, accelerating issue resolution, and championing continuous improvement. By streamlining processes, fostering collaboration, and anticipating risks, the PPTL ensures procurement consistently delivers maximum value and supports successful, on-time project execution.

Key missions:
The Project Procurement Team Leader (PPTL) is responsible for:
- Manage daily procurement execution activities, ensuring timely PO creation, approvals, documentation, and expediting in line with project schedules.

- Act as the first point of escalation for procurement execution and supplier-related issues, ensuring prompt resolution and clear communication with internal stakeholders.

- Track and report procurement performance metrics (On-Time Delivery, PO Cycle Time, Savings, Claim Resolution, etc.) and drive improvement actions.

- Conduct regular team meetings with the team.

- Provide onboarding and continuous training to the team members.

- Coach and mentor team members to strengthen performance and problem-solving.

- Foster a culture of operational discipline, compliance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- KPI Achievement (OTD, Say/Do, Function OTD, Claims)

- Continuous improvement mindset with ability to identify and implement efficiency gains.
