jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager – Industry and Oil & Gas
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
GE Vernova's Power Conversion & Storage business is looking for a commercially driven sales leader to take ownership of the Industry and Oil & Gas segment across Northern Europe. This is a senior leadership role with real scope – managing a team of sales and business development professionals, shaping the segment growth strategy, and driving meaningful revenue across the UK and Nordics.

Job Description
About the role
GE Vernova is a purpose−built global energy company, helping customers electrify and decarbonise the world. Our Power Conversion & Storage business works with customers across oil and gas, metals, mining, and heavy industry, delivering drives, controls, automation, solar, and battery energy storage solutions – as well as long−term service and upgrade programmes for existing installations.

This role sits at the heart of that growth ambition. You will directly lead a team of six sales professionals, set the direction for how we develop and win business across the segment and region, and personally engage at senior levels with key customers and partners. The territory spans the UK and Northern Europe, with a particular focus on expanding our presence in the Nordics.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and develop a team of sales managers and business development professionals, setting clear direction, individual plans, and performance expectations.
- Drive segment revenue growth in line with the annual operating plan, with a target of approximately $50M across Industry and Oil & Gas.
- Build and maintain senior−level customer relationships, identifying and converting strategic opportunities across new and existing accounts.
- Define and execute the segment's go−to−market strategy, including Scandinavian market development.
- Shape compelling value propositions by aligning customer requirements, market trends, and GE Vernova's full product and service portfolio.
- Manage and develop the opportunity pipeline using Salesforce, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting.
- Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including operations, commercial, and second−line account management to ensure full coverage of the installed base.
- Champion GE Vernova's values and standards across safety, quality, integrity, and customer focus.

Essential Requirements:
- Proven experience leading a commercial sales team in an industrial or energy−related environment.
- A background selling technically complex equipment or solutions – either into oil & gas, metals, mining, or heavy industry, or selling comparable products (such as drives, controls, switchgear, or power electronics) into industrial markets.
- Technical credibility sufficient to engage confidently with engineering and procurement stakeholders – whether gained through formal qualification or extensive industry experience.

- Strong commercial acumen, including pipeline management, value-based selling, and competitive positioning.

- Good understanding of the oil & gas market segment.
- Demonstrable experience using a CRM platform (Salesforce experience is a strong advantage).
- A valid driving license and passport, with the ability to travel across the UK and Northern Europe (up to approximately 20-30% of working time).

Nice-to-have qualifications:
- Degree in electrical engineering, automation, controls, or related discipline.
- Direct experience with power conversion products such as variable frequency drives or industrial automation systems.
- Familiarity with Scandinavian markets, customers, or business culture.
- Lean or Six Sigma certification.

What we offer
We believe the work we do matters – and we want the people who do it to thrive. Here is what you can expect when you join GE Vernova in the UK:
- A performance-based bonus under GE Vernova's sales incentive plan, rewarding delivery against your targets.
- A company car or car allowance as part of your benefits package.
- Access to FlexChoice, GE Vernova's flexible benefits programme, giving you the ability to tailor your package each year to suit your personal needs.
- A defined contribution pension scheme, with a competitive employer contribution through the Pension Saver plan.
- Comprehensive family private medical cover (inpatient, outpatient, and diagnostic), with the option to flex your level of cover.
- 26 days annual leave, with the option to buy or sell days through FlexChoice.
- Life assurance at above-market levels, with flexibility to increase cover.
- Group income protection, providing a proportion of your salary for up to five years if you are unable to work due to illness or injury.
- A Lifestyle Account – GE Vernova contributes £60 and matches your contributions up to £300 per year, which you can put towards fitness, wellbeing, or personal development.
- Digital learning resources, leadership development programmes, and on-the-job growth opportunities.

GE Vernova is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

jobs.title: Sales manager Protection and Control
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Vernova, our Grid Automation business is at the heart of the global energy transition. We provide an end-to-end portfolio of innovative products, systems, and services, ranging from Substation Protection and Automation to advanced cyber-security and asset performance management, that keep the world’s power grids resilient and efficient.

Job Description
Do you want to drive the commercial strategy for critical grid automation solutions that are powering the global energy transition?
GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Sales Manager, Protection and Control to join our Grid Automation team based in Finland.

GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.
Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Electrification Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.

Let’s Talk about the Role
The Sales Manager, Protection and Control will define and execute the commercial strategy for our grid automation portfolio across Finland.
You will act as a strategic partner to our customers, translating complex technical challenges into high-value solutions. You will lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, foster deep stakeholder relationships, and champion our values as you scale our regional footprint.

How You Will Make a Difference
- Driving commercial growth by proactively identifying and qualifying new business opportunities within the Protection & Control market.
- Leading the full sales cycle, from deal structuring and pricing strategy to final contract negotiation and closure.
- Collaborating effectively with channel partners to maximize regional coverage and commercial impact.
- Creating and implementing regional sales strategies, ensuring alignment with budgets and order intake targets.
- Fostering long-term customer intimacy, acting as a trusted advisor to key decision-makers on digital substations, cyber security, and asset performance.
- Improving regional success by providing rigorous reporting and actionable plans to navigate market shifts and project complexities.

Skills for Success
You should be a results-driven professional with:
- The ability to lead high-level presentations and build influence with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
- The capability to navigate complex sales scenarios and exercise professional judgment in proposal development.
- An understanding of market trends, competitor differentiation, and customer budgetary dynamics.
- An expertise in sales, tendering, or business development within the Protection & Control (P&C) sector.
- A formal education in Electrical Engineering is nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.
- Full proficiency in English and Finish.

Where and how you'll work
This is a permanent position based in Finland. We have a hybrid working model which gives you flexibility to work from our offices and from home.

Our Culture
Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.
Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.
Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

We're determined to be the best place to grow
We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.
We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity
We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.
As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.
Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Manager - Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
We are seeking an experienced Manager – Digital Transformation to join the Grid Automation Digital Technology organization, based at our Lisburn site in Northern Ireland.

Lisburn is an important Grid Automation site supporting Monitoring & Diagnostics (M&D) electronic equipment manufacturing as well as Research & Development activities. The role therefore requires someone who can effectively support a technology-intensive environment spanning manufacturing operations, engineering/R&D, enterprise applications and site infrastructure.

The role combines three key areas of responsibility:

-Act as the Digital Technology Site Reliability Leader for Lisburn, ensuring reliable, secure and effective DT services supporting M&D manufacturing, engineering and R&D operations.

-Plan, initiate and lead strategic Grid Automation Digital Technology projects and programs globally, working across manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, R&D, commercial and other business functions.

-Support the Grid Automation DT Project Management Office (PMO), strengthening project governance, portfolio management, prioritization, execution discipline and roadmap visibility.

The successful candidate will bring a broad Digital Technology background spanning manufacturing-site infrastructure, enterprise and business applications, business-process solutioning, SAP fundamentals, cybersecurity and project/program management.

A key expectation of the role is the ability to understand business and engineering needs and translate them into scalable, sustainable and harmonized DT solutions, promoting reuse of standard platforms and processes while minimizing unnecessary local customization.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities
Lisburn DT Site Leadership
- Act as the primary Digital Technology point of contact for the Lisburn site, partnering closely with site leadership, manufacturing, engineering, R&D and functional teams.
- Support the technology needs of the Grid Automation Monitoring & Diagnostics electronic equipment manufacturing operations and Research & Development organization based in Lisburn.
- Ensure reliable and secure operation of site DT infrastructure, network connectivity, workplace technology, servers, manufacturing systems and locally deployed applications.
- Understand critical manufacturing, engineering and R&D processes and ensure appropriate DT support, resilience, lifecycle management and business continuity.
- Partner with manufacturing and engineering teams to understand technology requirements associated with production, testing, quality, product development and related business processes.
- Coordinate with central infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, network and support teams to resolve operational issues and continuously improve site reliability.
- Manage and prioritize site DT requirements, operational risks, technical debt, infrastructure improvements and local technology initiatives.
- Support technology lifecycle planning and modernization of site infrastructure and applications.
- Ensure alignment with corporate DT architecture, infrastructure and cybersecurity standards.
- Ensure appropriate cybersecurity practices across site infrastructure, manufacturing systems and engineering/R&D environments, including alignment with applicable ISO 27001 and ISO 27002 information-security practices.
- Coordinate site-level DT incident resolution and escalation, ensuring appropriate engagement of global support and technology teams where required.
- Develop strong relationships with site stakeholders and maintain visibility of current and future DT requirements supporting business growth and operational priorities.

Global DT Projects & Programs
- Plan, initiate and lead end-to-end Digital Technology projects and programs supporting Grid Automation globally.
- Partner with business leaders, process owners and DT domain teams to understand business challenges, pain points and transformation opportunities.
- Support transformation initiatives across manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, R&D, quality, commercial, finance and other enterprise functions.
- Translate business requirements into scalable solution concepts and work with architects, SAP, infrastructure, cybersecurity and application teams to define and deliver appropriate solutions.
- Lead business application implementation, deployment, migration and transformation initiatives across manufacturing and enterprise environments.
- Facilitate business-process discovery and requirements definition, ensuring technology solutions address underlying process needs rather than individual application requests.
- Drive application and process harmonization, simplification and standardization across Grid Automation.
- Promote reuse of global platforms, common processes and standard solutions and challenge unnecessary localization or duplication.
- Evaluate solution options considering business value, architecture, cybersecurity, integration, supportability, scalability and total cost of ownership.
- Work effectively across global and regional teams and coordinate multiple technical and business stakeholders to deliver agreed outcomes.
- Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder communication through successful delivery and stabilization.
- Ensure appropriate project governance, testing, business readiness, training, deployment and transition-to-support activities.
- Monitor project outcomes and ensure delivered solutions achieve expected business benefits and remain aligned with the broader GA DT strategy and roadmap.

GA DT Project Management Office
- Support the Grid Automation Digital Technology portfolio and roadmap management process.
- Provide visibility of major GA DT projects and programs, including milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, financial status and delivery health.
- Establish and reinforce consistent project governance, planning, reporting and execution practices across the GA DT organization.
- Support project intake, evaluation and prioritization based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, urgency, resource requirements and available capacity.
- Support development and maintenance of the overall GA DT project and transformation roadmap.
- Prepare portfolio reviews, project health assessments, leadership-level dashboards and management reporting.
- Track major project actions, decisions, risks and escalations and drive timely follow-up with project leaders and stakeholders.
- Identify portfolio-level dependencies, resource constraints and execution risks and facilitate appropriate resolution or escalation.
- Support budget planning, project financial tracking and investment visibility across the DT portfolio.
- Promote appropriate project-management methodologies, tools, templates and governance practices.
- Support continuous improvement of GA DT project and program-management practices.
- Facilitate alignment across site, regional and global DT initiatives to minimize duplication and maximize reuse of common solutions.

Qualifications / Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems or a related discipline.
- Relevant experience working in Digital Technology / Information Technology within an industrial, electronics, engineering or manufacturing environment.
- Experience supporting or leading IT / DT activities within a manufacturing site.
- Good understanding of typical manufacturing-site infrastructure, including networks, servers, end-user computing, connectivity, hosting, backup, resilience and related technology services.
- Understanding of technology environments supporting electronics manufacturing, engineering and/or Research & Development activities would be highly relevant.
- Demonstrated experience implementing, deploying or supporting enterprise and business applications.
- Strong ability to understand business processes, identify requirements and work with business and technical teams to develop appropriate technology solutions.

jobs.title: Automation & Controls Programme  Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
About the Role Are you ready to shape the future of electrification?

As an Automation & Controls Programme Manager within our Power Conversion team, you will be at the heart of delivering cutting-edge technology that powers industries and utilities worldwide. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from concept to deployment, ensuring our automation and control solutions meet the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and performance.
This is a key role within a global, matrixed environment where your leadership will bridge the gap between design, engineering, and product strategy. You will drive innovation, manage risks, and translate ambitious visions into tangible, world-class products.

Job Description
What you will do

- Lead with Impact: You will guide multi-disciplinary teams through the full development lifecycle, using agile methods to keep projects on track and aligned with customer needs.
- Coordinate Complexity: By managing requirements definition, software development, and quality control, you will ensure seamless product delivery.
- Drive Strategy: You will take full ownership of program timelines, budgets, and resource planning. You will proactively manage risks, resolve technical bottlenecks, and lead design reviews to ensure successful milestones.
- Collaborate Globally: You will work across departmental lines—engaging with Product Management, Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Sales—to ensure that every product we launch delivers value and drives revenue.
- Champion Continuous Improvement: You will foster a culture of excellence, using data and lessons learned to refine our processes, reduce defects, and improve service and quality.

Who you are:

You are a collaborative professional who thrives in technical environments and excels at keeping teams focused on clear goals. You communicate with clarity and influence, and you enjoy navigating the balance between long-term strategy and daily execution.

- Essential Expertise: You bring substantial experience in managing R&D programs, ideally within electrical, electronics, or industrial control systems environments.
- Program Leadership: You are proficient in formal project management methodologies and tools (such as Smartsheet, MS Project, and JIRA/Confluence) to manage timelines, budgets, and cross-functional tasks.
- Risk & Quality: You have a solid understanding of risk, safety, and lean management principles.
- Communication: You possess the ability to bridge technical and commercial conversations, ensuring all stakeholders are updated and aligned.
- Qualifications: You hold a relevant degree in Engineering or have gained equivalent, significant experience in a professional engineering setting. A professional project management certification (e.g., PMP, Prince2) is highly valued.

It is a bonus if you have experience with cyber security practices, secure development lifecycles, or industrial communication protocols (such as Ethernet, LANs, and TCP/IP), but we encourage you to apply even if your experience looks a little different.

You can expect from us:

- Impactful Work: Opportunity to lead programmes that solve real-world energy and automation challenges.
- Growth: A global, collaborative team where your contribution is visible and valued.
- Flexible Working: We understand that work-life balance looks different for everyone. We are committed to discussing flexible working arrangements .
- Total Rewards: An attractive compensation package and a flexible benefits program that you can tailor to your personal needs.

Join us and help us electrify the world...

Additional Information

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
We are seeking a dynamic Lead Sourcing Specialist to join the GE Power Systems Korea team, responsible for procurement and supply chain execution for power plant equipment—especially HRSG (Heat Recovery Steam Generator) modules and related components. This role emphasizes localized sourcing, supplier development, and cost optimization for Global and Non-globalized commodities. Key performance areas include On-time delivery, Cost saving, Supplier identification and management, and Fulfillment aligned with GE’s annual operational goals. The position involves daily collaboration with Factory teams and global sourcing teams, and requires independent ownership of short-term deliverables while staying aligned with GE Vernova’s global sourcing framework.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

Execute sourcing strategies tailored to commodity categories specific to HRSG module fabrication, including but not limited to pressure parts (e.g., headers, tubes, harps), casing and structural steel (e.g., module frames, platforms, supports), piping materials (carbon and alloy steel), consumables, packaging materials, and transport structures such as shipping frames and lifting frame roof casing etc. and harp/module assembly.

Promote on-time delivery of purchasing items , supplier panel development and cost-saving initiatives to achieve OTD , deflation targets and improve sourcing KPIs.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Factory teams, manufacturing, supplier quality, and engineering team , project teams to address daily sourcing challenges and deliver value through continuous improvement.

Support new product development (NPI) and engineering projects by identifying and qualifying alternative suppliers and fostering supply chain flexibility.

Coordinate closely with global and regional sourcing leaders (material team) to ensure timely material availability, quality compliance, and productivity gains across the supply base.

Lead supplier negotiations with a focus on strategic alignment, total cost management, and risk mitigation.

Conduct supplier assessments in line with GE’s sourcing and compliance standards, ensuring sustainability and operational reliability.

Review and evaluate commercial proposals to select optimal vendors based on cost, quality, capacity, and delivery performance.

Develop and lead cost-out strategies in collaboration with internal stakeholders, influencing contracts and enabling long-term savings.

Manage procurement-related risks proactively, take ownership of issue resolution, and drive escalation handling where necessary.

Monitor supplier performance using key metrics and lead supplier improvement initiatives to elevate overall sourcing efficiency.

Communicate key sourcing initiatives and performance updates to senior stakeholders, supporting both tactical execution and strategic planning.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college, Minimum of 5 years' experience in Sourcing, Operations, Supply Chain and/or Commercial

Experienced commodity manager, advanced experience and demonstrated years in Sourcing & Commodity management.

English spoken.

Bachelor’s degree in Sourcing / Supply Chain Management preferred.

Previous Sourcing experience essential.

Knowledge of purchasing practices, principles, and procedures.

Ability to analyze and present statistical data.

Knowledge of MS Office applications, including some knowledge of intermediate level Excel functionality.

Excellent communication skills.

Good organizational and time management skills.

Must be able to balance multiple tasks in a challenging, fast paced work environment.

Exceptional analytical skills.

Demonstrated team player with a strong initiative to win.

Highly motivated self-starter.

Demonstrated professional oral / written communication and negation skills.

Significant project management skills.

Working knowledge of SAP ERP system.

Negotiation skills.

Experience with RFQ implementation and execution.

Ability to travel worldwide.
